```{r}
#| eval: false
line_graph <- billboard |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(wk1), !is.na(wk2), !is.na(wk3), !is.na(wk4), !is.na(wk5)) |>
  dplyr::slice(1:3) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(wk1:wk5, names_to = "week", values_to = "rank") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, group = track, color = track)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ track)

ggsave("line_graph.png", plot = line_graph)
```

 my code through exercise 12
```{r}
#| eval: false

billboard |>
  dplyr::filter(wk1 < 101) |>
  dplyr::arrange(wk1) |>
  dplyr::mutate(improvement = wk1 - wk2) |>
  dplyr::relocate(improvement, .after = wk2) |>
  dplyr::select(artist:improvement) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    week1 = wk1,
    week2 = wk2
  )
```
